def: self-satisfaction, i.e. (abstractly) contentedness, or (concretely) a competence

occurrences.text: And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work:
But godliness with contentment is great gain.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
